column1: # Hand-curated motif overrides for the FGFR bundle.
# 8E1X is FGFR2 and the paper's design discussion is FGFR3, so every residue the text names
# appears here in the deposited FGFR2 numbering with its FGFR3 equivalent spelled out in the
# role_note. BUILD_SPEC 9.2 asks for the dual numbering to be handled rather than hidden:
# this is where that happens, and the note travels with the residue everywhere in the app.
# Source: Shvartsbart et al. 2022, Figure 2 (FGFR3 numbering) and Figure 3 (FGFR2, 8E1X).

column4: Lys517 catalytic lysine. FGFR3 numbering: Lys508. The amide carbonyl was modelled hydrogen bonding here
Val564 gatekeeper. FGFR3 numbering: Val555. The mutants that defeat the approved drugs are V555I/L/M/F in FGFR3 and V564I/L/M/F in FGFR2
Ala567 hinge. FGFR3 numbering: Ala558. The imidazole nitrogen makes the hinge hydrogen bond here
Asn571 lower hinge. FGFR3 numbering: Asn562. This is the residue the tetrahydrofuran ether was designed to reach, and the crystal structure confirms the contact
